english.title: Producer or authorised representative fail to join scheme before 15th November

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a producer who was required by regulation 14(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013 to be a member of a scheme,]_
(B)_[an authorised representative who had been appointed under regulation 14(2)(a) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013,]_

failed, in respect of a compliance period, to join a scheme on or before 15th November **(..SPECIFY YEAR..), being the year immediately preceding the commencement of that compliance period
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14(4), 90(1) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a producer required under reg 14(1) to be a member of a scheme or an authorised representative appointed under reg 14(2)
failed to join a scheme on or before 15th November in the year immediately preceding the commencement of that compliance period

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence is subject to regulation 14(5)

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine
Indictment: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
